summary.text: Eric Lucan is a Democratic candidate for California State Assembly District 12 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces fellow Democrat Jackie Elward in a race with no incumbent.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he has served for 19 years in local office, including 11 years on a City Council and the last four years as a County Supervisor.

paragraphs.text: Lucan earned an M.B.A. from Georgia State University in 2005, and Ballotpedia lists his career experience as working as a businessman.
In the survey, Lucan said he is a three-time mayor and a small business owner.
He listed affordability and cost of living, the local economy, resilience and climate change, and defending democracy as his campaign messages.
He named Senator Adam Schiff and Congressman Jared Huffman among his supporters.
